system.description:
Requirements: Mind (2)

You are skilled at finding tactical openings for your allies to exploit.

As an Action, choose an ally within 10 spaces. The target can make a single attack against a creature of your choice, using a melee weapon, a ranged weapon. or a single-target spell.

If they do so, they gain bonus dice on their attack or casting check equal to your Mind.

A creature can only benefit from this ability once per round.
